headline: Licensing softness and a higher tax rate compress profit
summary_short: Dolby's quarter ended June 26, 2026 (shard label FY2026 Q2; company's own fiscal Q3 2026) posted revenue of $305M (-3.3% y/y) and net income of $29M ($0.30 diluted EPS), as licensing softened across Mobile, PC and Broadcast and the effective tax rate jumped to 33.3% from 16.2%.
summary_long: Licensing revenue fell 3% y/y (-$7.6M) on lower Mobile revenue (minimum-volume-commitment timing) and lower Broadcast/PC recoveries, partly offset by higher CE and Other (Dolby Cinema, Atmos-in-auto) revenue; Products and Services revenue fell 12% on weaker cinema-products demand. Licensing gross margin slipped to 92% from 93% on mix; Products/Services margin improved to 22% from 13% on lower Dolby Cinema warranty costs. Operating income fell as G&A rose 5% on litigation and patent-pool legal costs and a new $4.0M restructuring charge was recorded. Effective tax rate rose to 33.3% from 16.2% on lower R&D credit benefits, driving diluted EPS to $0.30 from $0.48. Cash and equivalents were $669.4M, down from $701.9M at fiscal year-start on $200.0M YTD buybacks and $102.7M in dividends.

drivers.explanation: Licensing revenue fell 3% y/y on lower Mobile/Broadcast/PC royalties (minimum-volume-commitment timing, lower recoveries), partly offset by CE and Other; effective tax rate jumped to 33.3% from 16.2% on lower R&D credit benefits, compounding the profit decline.

Mobile revenue fell on timing of minimum volume commitments (partly offset by imaging patents); Broadcast and PC fell on lower recoveries and minimum-volume timing; CE and Other rose on recoveries, Dolby Cinema and Atmos-in-auto adoption.

The filing's own comparisons are this quarter vs the same quarter a year ago, not vs the prior sequential quarter; the large q/q drop reflects a stronger prior shard quarter and is not addressed in the MD&A.

Licensing gross margin fell to 92% from 93% mainly on revenue mix; Products and Services gross margin rose to 22% from 13% on lower Dolby Cinema warranty and maintenance costs even as products revenue fell.

G&A rose 5% on higher litigation and patent-pool program legal costs; a new June 2026 restructuring plan added a $4.0M charge (targeting ~$2M FY2026 / $12M FY2027 savings); R&D and S&M were roughly flat.

Effective tax rate rose to 33.3% from 16.2% on lower R&D tax-credit benefits, layering onto the operating-income decline; a $34.5M YTD litigation accrual (MPEG LA judgment) was offset by an equal indemnification asset.
Tracks the net income decline; diluted share count fell slightly (94.5M vs 96.9M) on continued buybacks, a modest partial offset.
